description.value:
Traits Signal

Choose one willing ally. That ally permanently counts as being within range of your Broadcast while you are both on the same continent, whether or not you are broadcasting at the time — when you begin a Broadcast, they are in range from the first moment. To choose a different ally, you must spend 1 week of downtime transmitting, during which you can undertake no other downtime activity.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB3 — modifies Broadcast's own range/targeting rule; no item to alter. No "Broadcast" stance/aura item is ever instantiated as an Item with its own system.rules anywhere in this corpus. The shape (a stance whose aura buffs allies) is real and buildable in pf2e via Aura + a companion effect item -- but no such Broadcast item exists among this class's files to attach a rule element to.
